plugins.name: architect-agent
plugins.description: Solution Architect agent you start and stop. Input: spec, feature list + acceptance criteria, wireframes, user journeys, technical standards, threat model, ADR approvals. Output: architecture document, data model, API contracts, ADRs, feasibility notes. Grows an architecture skill from every feature.

plugins.name: backend-agent
plugins.description: Backend Developer agent you start and stop. Input: task breakdown, feature list + acceptance criteria, architecture document, API contracts, database schema, technical standards, implementation guidelines + review checklist, event instrumentation spec, bug reports, security findings. Output: backend pull requests with code plus unit, integration and contract tests. Grows a backend skill from every feature.

plugins.name: cto-agent
plugins.description: CTO agent you start and stop. Input: Requirements Specification + ADRs. Output: Technical Standards + ADR Approvals. Grows a review skill from every feature.

plugins.name: database-agent
plugins.description: Database Engineer agent you start and stop. Input: data model, requirements specification, technical standards. Output: database schema, migration scripts, indexing notes. Grows a database skill from every feature.

plugins.name: frontend-agent
plugins.description: Frontend Developer agent you start and stop. Input: task breakdown, feature list + acceptance criteria, high-fidelity designs, design system, interaction specs, visual assets, API contracts, technical standards, implementation guidelines + review checklist, event instrumentation spec, bug reports, security findings. Output: frontend pull requests with code plus unit, component and integration tests. Grows a frontend skill from every feature.

plugins.name: qa-agent
plugins.description: QA Engineer agent you start and stop. Input: release candidate, feature list + acceptance criteria, architecture document, AI evaluation results, coverage report. Output: test strategy and test plan, bug reports, test summary and quality gate decision. Grows a testing skill from every feature and release.

plugins.name: security-agent
plugins.description: Security Engineer agent you start and stop. Input: architecture document, release candidate, compliance obligations. Output: threat model, security findings and remediation, security gate decision. Grows a security skill from every feature and release.

plugins.name: techlead-agent
plugins.description: Technical Lead agent you start and stop. Input: architecture document, API contracts, technical standards, prioritized backlog, frontend/backend/mobile/AI-feature/human pull requests. Output: technical task breakdown, implementation guidelines and code review checklist, code review decisions. Grows a delivery and review skill from every feature.
